name: Legashi Horns
summary: A furbolg of Ursolan asks you to bring horns from slain Legashi satyr. Each bundle marks your service to the Blackmaw.

sections.title: Among the Blackmaw
sections.body: The other furbolg of the Blackmaw are harder to persuade, so your efforts against the Legashi continue. Their slain satyr bear the horns you are asked to bring back. Each bundle gives the tribe a sign of your service, and the furbolg of Ursolan will hear of your deeds.

faq.answer: A furbolg of the Blackmaw asks you to bring horns from slain Legashi satyr.

faq.q: Why do they want the horns?
faq.answer: Each bundle marks your service to the Blackmaw and helps persuade the other members of the tribe.
The Legashi are satyr, and the Blackmaw ask you to bring horns from those you slay.
You have already proven yourself to the furbolg who speaks for the Blackmaw, but the rest of the tribe is harder to persuade.

faq.q: Where will the furbolg hear of my deeds?
faq.answer: The furbolg who speaks for the Blackmaw says word of your deeds will spread among the furbolg of Ursolan.
